import os,json,pathlib,subprocess
R=pathlib.Path('E:/PCControlAutonomyR41')
J=R/'data/pc-control-supervisor.json'
entry=pathlib.Path(os.environ['APPDATA'])/'Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup/PCControl_R41_Observer.cmd'
owner=json.loads((R/'WATCHER_R41.json').read_text('utf8')) if (R/'WATCHER_R41.json').exists() else {}

pid=owner.get('pid')
ps="""$p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId = %s' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -ne $p) { [pscustomobject]@{pid=$p.ProcessId; executable=$p.Name; matches=($p.CommandLine -like '*PCControlAutonomyR41*pc-autonomy-daemon.js*' -and $p.CommandLine -like '*--watch*')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }"""%(pid or 0)
